verdict.rationale: First-party developer docs say the DBX Platform lets apps add Dropbox features "such as ... sharing" and offers official SDKs, so sharing is at least nominally programmable. Separately, the plans page lists password-protected files and the help center mentions customizing links, but nothing ties these to the API. The evidence never shows API endpoints for creating or revoking shared links, or for setting visibility, password, or expiry. Missing for 10: documented API calls to create shared links, API-configurable visibility/password/expiry settings, API link revocation, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
